title: The retired-entry divergence on the thread resource is left open, not folded into U4
context: U5 taught the briefing to hide retired artifacts and risks. renderDetailThread on logbook://thread/{id} does not filter on the tombstone, so once U4 makes retirement writable the two surfaces disagree: the briefing hides a retired entry and the thread resource still shows it. The mechanical fix conflicts with test/contract/content-rendered.test.ts, a closed census whose generic boolean rule synthesises retired: true, so filtering hides its sentinels and the census fails.
options: Filter retired entries in renderDetailThread and change the content census fixture semantics in the same unit
Leave the divergence open, record it as a risk, and decide the census semantics separately
Make the census exempt retired from its generic boolean rule
outcome: Left open and recorded as a risk. Fixing it means changing what the content census's synthesised fixtures mean, which is a design decision above the writers unit's ceiling and not something to fold in silently. The lead flagged it explicitly as a judgement call open to being overturned. Whoever takes it owns the census semantics question first, then the filter.
